name: SysML v2 Coupled-Requirements Benchmark
description: A benchmark of 20 test cases for evaluating automated generation of SysML v2 models from multiple coupled natural-language requirements. Each case contains 21 requirements: one overview-level component introduction and 20 expanded requirements covering structural modeling and requirements traceability (requirements 1-15, including attributes, ports and interfaces, and subject-bound requirement definitions) and parametric constraints (requirements 16-20, multivariable coupled equations for continuous torque, thermal rise, efficiency, overspeed margin, and cooling flow). The introductions are systematically extended from the public component descriptions released with Cibrian et al., Computers in Industry, vol. 172, art. 104350 (2025). Expanded requirements follow typical patterns in RTCA DO-160G, MIL-STD-810H, and ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148, and were manually reviewed. This dataset accompanies the paper "A Two-Stage Automated Modeling Framework from Multi-Constraint Coupled Requirements to SysML v2". Each case is intended as a single joint-generation task producing one complete, valid SysML v2 model covering all 21 requirements; suggested metrics are compilation success rate against the official SysML v2 validator and per-requirement semantic fidelity on a 1-3 scale.
